subrules.name: 702.195a
subrules.rule: Accomplice is a triggered ability. “Accomplice” means “Whenever another creature you control attacks, you may tap this creature.”

subrules.name: 702.195b
subrules.rule: A creature “becomes an accomplice to [a creature]” when the former creature is tapped as a result of a resolving accomplice ability that triggered from the latter creature's being declared as an attacker. The latter creature is also called the creature the former creature accompliced.

mechanics.original_reminder: Whenever another creature you control attacks, you may tap this creature.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Whenever another creature you control attacks, you may tap this creature. If this creature was tapped this way, have the first creature perform the accomplice association action with objects tapped this way.

executable_definitions.reminder: Whenever another creature you control attacks, you may tap this creature. If this creature was tapped this way, have the first creature perform the accomplice association action with objects tapped this way.

subrules.name: 702.195a
subrules.rule: Accomplice is a triggered ability. “Accomplice” means “Whenever another creature you control attacks, you may tap this creature.”

subrules.name: 702.195b
subrules.rule: A creature “becomes an accomplice to [a creature]” when the former creature is tapped as a result of a resolving accomplice ability that triggered from the latter creature's being declared as an attacker. The latter creature is also called the creature the former creature accompliced.
